summary.zh: 设计微交互、动效与操作反馈
summary.en: Microinteractions, motion, and user feedback patterns.

description.zh: 规划按钮反馈、加载状态、转场动画与结果提示，让交互过程清楚可预期。适合打磨界面的细节体验，或为已有流程补上缺失的状态与反馈。
description.en: Plans button feedback, loading states, transitions, and result messaging so interactions stay predictable. Useful for polishing interface details or adding missing states and feedback to a flow.
